name: fix-pattern
description: Fix-loop assist (#127): which recorded fix pattern from the recreation procedure applies to the first hot band, given the anchor deltas bucketed into words? Select from the catalogue; the agent applies the pattern. Never a patch.

fields.round: { page, width, pixelPct, heightDelta, hotBand: 'y 500–1000: 23 %', anchors: ['hero: build top +0 px, height +48 px vs live', …], chrome: parity summary lines, flags: the round's content / visual flag lines (few), notes }

instructions.question: Which fix pattern explains the first hot band in `round`?
instructions.focus: Read the anchor deltas top-down: the first section whose top or height differs names the cause; everything below it is offset. Pick the pattern for that section.

sizing_model.what: A container or module is a different width or cap than live: a fixed width where live is fluid, a missing max-width, a wrong cap at the probe width.
signals: a section's height differs at one breakpoint only
widths differ while text is identical

wrap_junction_margins.what: Collapsing or doubled margins where a card or band meets its neighbour: a section is taller or shorter by a margin-sized amount with identical content.
signals: height delta of 16–64 px on a section whose inner boxes match

span_face_fork.what: Text renders in a different face or weight on inner spans: line wraps differ, glyph-edge noise across text-dense bands, a FONT FORK flag.

scrim_luminance.what: An overlay scrim, gradient or tint on imagery differs: the band is a uniform luminance offset over a hero or card image.
signals: hero band hot with matching geometry
diff is a wash, not edges

fixed_chrome_static.what: Fixed or sticky chrome replicated in flow (or vice versa): the header, a banner or a strip repeats or is missing at stitch seams, pushing everything below.
signals: every band offset by the chrome height

granularity_parity.what: The build splits or joins elements differently from live: a list rendered as paragraphs, a heading and lede in one element, JOIN/SPLIT content-diff reds.

chrome_generation.what: A different header or footer generation than the one captured: nav rows, strips or store selectors present on one side only.

capture_state.what: Live content that varies between loads — a carousel on another slide, a rotating offer, a hydration placeholder, lazy images not yet loaded — not a build defect.
signals: the hot band moves between rounds
MISSING CTA on a rotating hero

pipeline_transform.what: The delivery pipeline changed the markup: paragraph-wrapped pictures, unwrapped paragraphs, empty metadata section padding, rewritten media paths (published regime only).
signals: a few px per section everywhere

media_geometry.what: An image or video box renders at another size or crop: aspect ratio, object-fit, missing height attribute, a stretched or unloaded image.
signals: hero height differs by the image delta

appendNone.none: None of the catalogue patterns fits the first hot band.

instructions.question: Which section in `round.anchors` is the first (top-most) whose top or height differs from live?
instructions.focus: Name the section as it appears in the anchor lines; if every section matches, answer none.

appendNone.none: Every section matches, or the anchors are missing.
